limitations: These observations are not hard quotas, peak storage, physical allocation or host-wide I/O isolation.

Unsupported metadata and bounded enumeration failures withhold a score rather than silently omit objects.
Low-space and API-error controls are synthetic; they do not fill the host disk or prove physical quota enforcement.
No real model inference, comparative skill gain, hosted acceptance or commercial-readiness result is established.
